purpose: Measure output-qualified HTTP aggregate decode without the ambiguous text-only oracle or same-process repeat hysteresis in r1.

identity.gpu: one Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GiB

measurement.endpoint: llama.cpp native HTTP /completion, selected because this runtime returns auditable raw token IDs there; OpenAI-compatible /v1/completions does not honor the vLLM return_token_ids extension
measurement.required_output_gate: 128 complete returned token IDs per request, exactly equal to that prompt's sequential oracle; zero cached tokens; no cross-request response identity
measurement.required_stability_gate: both fresh-server attempts pass output gates; per-point aggregate spread is reported and any point above 10% relative range remains diagnostic
measurement.aggregate_metric: sum reported completion tokens divided by batch wall time
